title: [Bug][Subscription Billing] Wrong number of days on vendor contract deferrals when the billing period lies within a single calendar month
summary: Vendor subscription contract deferrals now calculate the correct number of days when a billing period falls entirely within a single calendar month, fixing day counts that previously extended to the month's end.
key_points: Single-period billing schedules now use the actual billing period date range instead of calendar month days
Added dedicated logic branch for one-period schedules matching customer deferral handling
Multi-period schedules remain unaffected with correct partial and full month day counts
Eight new test cases cover single and multi-period scenarios with various date ranges
Deferral amounts were already correct; only day count field was wrong
